prepicks.question: Before any AI draft is shown: tap every line you would give a second look, judging from the ledger alone. A line you leave untapped counts as one you would let stand.
prepicks.note: Taken from the ledger alone, before any sentence of the AI draft is shown, and required: the page offers no way past it without at least one tapped line. A tapped account counts as a flag on each of its round one lines and an untapped one as let it stand. readByLine and finalByLine run in card order, F a flag and S let it stand. afterDraft compares the read with the final call on each line, which was made after reading the draft and the file on the card and, in practice mode, the reveals of the lines before it. It describes agreement with the key on a keyed exercise. It is not scored, adds no points, and is not a measure of learning.
